answer: A concrete defense is a refundable identity bond. Each agent must lock 500 POA before it can act, and that bond is the bridge tying one identity to real stake. 1,000 sybils then require 1,000 separate bonds, so 500,000 POA is frozen at once. Peer attestation catches misbehavior and slashes the offending bond, so an attacker cannot quietly whisper fake endorsements between puppet accounts: every fake reputation needs its own locked bond, stacking up like timber, which makes large sybil farms economically unviable.
